question: How many users are there in each age category (20s, 30s, 40s, 50s, and others)?
sql:
SELECT 
    age_category,
    COUNT(*) AS user_count
FROM (
    SELECT 
        CASE 
            WHEN birth_date IS NULL OR birth_date = '' THEN 'Others'
            ELSE
                CASE
                    WHEN (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date('2024-01-01')) - CAST(SUBSTR(birth_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER)) >= 20 AND (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date('2024-01-01')) - CAST(SUBSTR(birth_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER)) < 30 THEN '20s'
                    WHEN (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date('2024-01-01')) - CAST(SUBSTR(birth_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER)) >= 30 AND (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date('2024-01-01')) - CAST(SUBSTR(birth_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER)) < 40 THEN '30s'
                    WHEN (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date('2024-01-01')) - CAST(SUBSTR(birth_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER)) >= 40 AND (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date('2024-01-01')) - CAST(SUBSTR(birth_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER)) < 50 THEN '40s'
                    WHEN (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date('2024-01-01')) - CAST(SUBSTR(birth_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER)) >= 50 AND (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date('2024-01-01')) - CAST(SUBSTR(birth_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER)) < 60 THEN '50s'
                    ELSE 'Others'
                END
        END AS age_category
    FROM mst_users
)
GROUP BY age_category
ORDER BY age_category

    COUNT(*) AS user_count
FROM (
    SELECT 
        CASE 
            WHEN birth_date IS NULL OR birth_date = '' THEN 'Others'
            ELSE
                CASE
                    WHEN (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date('2024-01-01')) - CAST(SUBSTR(birth_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER)) >= 20 AND (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date('2024-01-01')) - CAST(SUBSTR(birth_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER)) < 30 THEN '20s'
                    WHEN (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date('2024-01-01')) - CAST(SUBSTR(birth_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER)) >= 30 AND (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date('2024-01-01')) - CAST(SUBSTR(birth_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER)) < 40 THEN '30s'
                    WHEN (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date('2024-01-01')) - CAST(SUBSTR(birth_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER)) >= 40 AND (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date('2024-01-01')) - CAST(SUBSTR(birth_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER)) < 50 THEN '40s'
                    WHEN (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date('2024-01-01')) - CAST(SUBSTR(birth_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER)) >= 50 AND (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date('2024-01-01')) - CAST(SUBSTR(birth_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER)) < 60 THEN '50s'
                    ELSE 'Others'
                END
        END AS age_category
    FROM mst_users
)
GROUP BY age_category
ORDER BY age_category
